text: A culmination is the high point or final result of a long process. Here, the super-long Sydney flights are the peak of the ultra-long-haul era.
To sustain something is to keep it going over time. Here, Qantas thinks enough people will buy tickets to keep a flight running every day.
To spur something is to push it to happen or to speed it up. Here, the new flight probably will not push airlines to start lots of other very long routes.
A flag carrier is the main airline that a country is most closely linked with. Qantas is Australia's and Iberia is Spain's.
A hub is a big, busy airport where an airline brings many flights together so passengers can switch planes. Doha and Hong Kong are hubs.
A nonstop flight goes from start to finish without landing anywhere in between.
A record is the best result ever reached, like the longest flight or the fastest run.
A scheduled flight is one that runs at planned times, like a bus, and is not a special one-time trip.
Commercial means for business and for paying customers. A commercial flight carries ordinary passengers who buy tickets.
Measly means very small or disappointing. Here, the writer jokes that 19 hours is a tiny amount compared with 22.
A marathon is a very long race, over 26 miles. Here, it means a flight that goes on for a very long time.
A fleet is a group of vehicles owned by one company. Qantas has ordered a fleet of 12 planes.
Customised means changed to fit a special need. These planes are built differently from the regular ones.
Ultra-long-range describes a plane that can fly an extremely long way without stopping to refuel.
To reckon means to think or believe something after weighing it up. Here, Qantas believes there are enough passengers.
Demand is how many people want to buy something. If lots of people want a flight, demand is high.
Configured means set up in a certain way. A cabin configured with premium seats has only fancy seats.
Premium means higher quality and costing more. Premium seats are roomier and cost far more than economy seats.
Economy is the cheapest class of airplane seat, with the least space.
To blur something is to make the line between two things hard to see. Here, a first-class seat feels almost like a hotel room.
Boutique describes something small, stylish and fancy, like a little hotel with only a few special rooms.
Accommodation is a place to stay, such as a hotel room.
Hydration means getting enough water into your body. A hydration station is a place to get a drink.
Aka means "also known as." It introduces another name for the same thing.
In effect means "in reality, even if not said directly."
A spate is a sudden rush of many things at once, such as a spate of new routes.
Long-haul means a flight of many hours. Ultra-long-haul means the very longest of these.
Fuel is what an engine burns to make power. Planes burn jet fuel.
Well-to-do means rich enough to buy nice things easily.
To shell out means to spend a lot of money, often unwillingly.
Migrants are people who move from one country to live in another.
A corridor here means a busy path between two places that many people travel along.
Composed of means made up of. A group composed of three types has three parts.
A variant is a slightly different version of something. The XLR is a variant of a short-hop plane.
A single-aisle plane has one walkway down the middle, so it is narrower and smaller than a jumbo jet.
Unprofitable means losing money instead of making it.
A supply chain is the path that parts and goods take from the factories that make them to the company that needs them.
A disruption is something that breaks up the normal flow and causes delays.
To accelerate means to speed up. Here, plane deliveries will happen faster.
Point-to-point means going straight between two places without a stop at a hub in the middle.
To peak means to reach the highest point. After that, things usually go down.
Qantas is the biggest airline in Australia.
Airbus is a European company that builds passenger jets.
Boeing is an American company that builds passenger jets. The 777 is one of its big planes.
Iberia is the main airline of Spain.
IndiGo is India's biggest airline.
Ryanair is a low-cost European airline known for cheap short flights between cities.
Singapore Airlines is the national airline of Singapore, a small island country in Asia.
Porto is a city on the coast of Portugal.
